अतस्तौ मायया कॢप्तौ बन्धमोक्षौ न चात्मनि ।
निष्कले निष्क्रिये शान्ते निरवद्ये निरञ्जने अद्वितीये परे तत्त्वे व्योमवत्कल्पना कुतः ॥ ५७३ ॥
verses.roman:
atastau māyayā kḷptau bandhamokṣau na cātmani |
niṣkale niṣkriye śānte niravadye nirañjane advitīye pare tattve vyomavatkalpanā kutaḥ || 573 ||
verses.colloquial:
atas tau maayayaa kliptau bandha mokshau na ca aatmani |
nishkale nishkriye shaante niravadye niranjane adviitiiye pare tattve vyomavat kalpanaa kutah || 573 ||
verses.translation_reworded: So this bondage and Liberation are created by Māyā and are not in the Ātman. How could any idea of limitation apply to the Supreme Truth, which has no parts and no activity, and is calm, beyond reproach, stainless, and One without a second? It could no more apply there than to the infinite sky.

verses.sanskrit:
न निरोधो न चोत्पत्तिर्न बद्धो न च साधकः ।
न मुमुक्षुर्न वै मुक्त इत्येषा परमार्थता ॥ ५७४ ॥
verses.roman:
na nirodho na cotpattirna baddho na ca sādhakaḥ |
na mumukṣurna vai mukta ityeṣā paramārthatā || 574 ||
verses.colloquial:
na nirodho na ca utpattir na baddho na ca saadhakaah |
na mumukshur na vai mukta iti eshaa paramaartha taa || 574 ||
verses.translation_reworded: There is no death and no birth, no bound soul and no struggling soul, no seeker of Liberation and no liberated one. This is the ultimate truth.

verses.sanskrit:
सकलनिगमचूडास्वान्तसिद्धान्तरूपं परमिदमतिगुह्यं दर्शितं ते मयाद्य ।
अपगतकलिदोषं कामनिर्मुक्तबुद्धिं स्वसुतवदसकृत्त्वां भावयित्वा मुमुक्षुम् ॥ ५७५ ॥
verses.roman:
sakalanigamacūḍāsvāntasiddhāntarūpaṃ paramidamatiguhyaṃ darśitaṃ te mayādya |
apagatakalidoṣaṃ kāmanirmuktabuddhiṃ svasutavadasakṛttvāṃ bhāvayitvā mumukṣum || 575 ||
verses.colloquial:
sakala nigama cuudaa svaanta siddhaanta ruupam param idam ati guhyam darshitam te mayaa adya |
apagata kali dosham kaama nirmukta buddhim sva suta vad asakrit tvaam bhaavayitvaa mumukshum || 575 ||
verses.translation_reworded: Today I have repeatedly revealed to you, as to my own son, this excellent and deep secret, the innermost meaning of all Vedanta, the crest of the Vedas. I did so regarding you as an aspirant to Liberation, cleansed of the taints of this Dark Age, with a mind free of desires.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>Blessed Disciple Liberated</vt>
इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं प्रश्रयेण कृतानतिः ।
स तेन समनुज्ञातो ययौ निर्मुक्तबन्धनः ॥ ५७६ ॥
verses.roman:
<vt>Blessed Disciple Liberated</vt>
iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ praśrayeṇa kṛtānatiḥ |
sa tena samanujñāto yayau nirmuktabandhanaḥ || 576 ||
verses.colloquial:
<vt>Blessed Disciple Liberated</vt>
iti shrutvaa guror vaakyam prashrayena kritaanatihi |
sa tena samanujnyaato yayau nirmukta bandhanaah || 576 ||
verses.translation_reworded: On hearing these words of the Guru, the disciple bowed down before him in reverence and, with his leave, went on his way, freed from bondage.

verses.sanskrit:
गुरुरेव सदानन्दसिन्धौ निर्मग्नमानसः ।
पावयन्वसुधां सर्वाण्विचचार निरन्तरः ॥ ५७७ ॥
verses.roman:
gurureva sadānandasindhau nirmagnamānasaḥ |
pāvayanvasudhāṃ sarvāṇvicacāra nirantaraḥ || 577 ||
verses.colloquial:
gurur eva sadaa aananda sindhau nirmagna maanasah |
paavayan vasudhaam sarvaam vicacaara nirantarah || 577 ||
verses.translation_reworded: And the Guru, his mind immersed in the ocean of Existence and Bliss Absolute, travelled on, truly purifying the whole world, with every idea of difference banished from his mind.

verses.sanskrit:
इत्याचार्यस्य शिष्यस्य संवादेनात्मलक्षणम् ।
निरूपितं मुमुक्षूणां सुखबोधोपपत्तये ॥ ५७८ ॥
verses.roman:
ityācāryasya śiṣyasya saṃvādenātmalakṣaṇam |
nirūpitaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ sukhabodhopapattaye || 578 ||
verses.colloquial:
iti aachaaryasya shishyasya samvaadena aatma lakshanam |
niruupitam mumukshunaam sukha bodha upapattaye || 578 ||
verses.translation_reworded: In this way, through a dialogue between Teacher and disciple, the nature of the Ātman has been established, so that seekers of Liberation may grasp it easily.

verses.sanskrit:
<vt>The Glory of the Textbook</vt>
हितमिदमुपदेशमाद्रियन्तां विहितनिरस्तसमस्तचित्तदोषाः ।
भवसुखविरताः प्रशान्तचित्ताः श्रुतिरसिका यतयो मुमुक्षवो ये ॥ ५७९ ॥
verses.roman:
<vt>The Glory of the Textbook</vt>
hitamidamupadeśamādriyantāṃ vihitanirastasamastacittadoṣāḥ |
bhavasukhaviratāḥ praśāntacittāḥ śrutirasikā yatayo mumukṣavo ye || 579 ||
verses.colloquial:
<vt>The Glory of the Textbook</vt>
hitam idam upadesham aadriyantaam vihita nirasta samasta citta doshaaḥ |
bhava sukha virataaḥ prashaanta chittaaḥ shruti rasikaa yatayo mumukshavo ye || 579 ||
verses.translation_reworded: May those Sannyasins who seek Liberation, who have cleansed their minds of every taint by following the prescribed methods, who turn away from worldly pleasures, who are serene of mind and delight in the Śruti, value this beneficial teaching!

verses.sanskrit:
संसाराध्वनि तापभानुकिरणप्रोद्भूतदाहव्यथा खिन्नानां जलकाङ्क्षया मरुभुवि भ्रान्त्या परिभ्राम्यताम् ।
अत्यासन्नसुधाम्बुधिं सुखकरं ब्रह्माद्वयं दर्शयत्य् एषा शंकरभारती विजयते निर्वाणसंदायिनी ॥ ५८0 ॥
verses.roman:
saṃsārādhvani tāpabhānukiraṇaprodbhūtadāhavyathā khinnānāṃ jalakāṅkṣayā marubhuvi bhrāntyā paribhrāmyatām |
atyāsannasudhāmbudhiṃ sukhakaraṃ brahmādvayaṃ darśayaty eṣā śaṃkarabhāratī vijayate nirvāṇasaṃdāyinī || 580 ||
verses.colloquial:
samsaara adhvani taapa bhaanu kirana prodbhuuta daaha vyathaa khinnaanaam jala kaankshayaa maru bhuvi bhraantyaa paribhraamyataam |
ati aasanna sudhaa ambudhim sukha karam brahma advayam darshayati eshaa shamkara bhaaratii vijayate nirvaana samdaayinii || 580 ||
verses.translation_reworded: There are those who, in the course of worldly life, are afflicted by the burning pain of the scorching sunshine of threefold misery, and who wander deluded through a desert in search of water. For them here is Shankara's triumphant message, showing that the soothing ocean of nectar, Brahman, the One without a second, is close at hand, to lead them on to Liberation.
